other_conditions: Must be a micro or small manufacturing enterprise.

Must have availed a term loan under Technology up‑gradation/modernization schemes, National Equity Funds Scheme (Micro/Small Enterprises Funding Scheme), ISO Certification/R&D under NSIC‑SIDCO Consortium, or Credit Guarantee Fund Trust Scheme.

New enterprises that have set up facilities or existing enterprises upgrading plant and machinery with state‑of‑the‑art technology, as listed in the Credit Linked Capital Subsidy Scheme (CLCSS) guidelines, are eligible.
benefits_summary: Provides a 5% interest subsidy on term loans for up to 5 years, with a maximum subsidy of ₹20 lakh (₹25 lakh for technology up‑gradation loans) and a per‑loan cap of ₹10 lakh.
